text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up — Ryan has submitted notice, last day is 2025-06-13. Can we align on benefits end date, COBRA outreach, and an access removal schedule? Need laptop return plan + exit interview slot. @Sam please own deprovisioning timeline.
Sam (IT Ops): Got it. Quick Q: does Ryan need org email forwarding after last day? Also which GCP projects should we keep a service account for?
Maya (People Ops): Prefer email forwarding for 30 days, unless Leo objects. GCP: only prod-monitoring and shared-data. Leo will confirm runbooks.
Leo (Eng Manager): Confirmed — keep a read-only service account for prod-monitoring for 30 days, give to me and @Sam. Ryan please create a short handover doc w/ pages for ongoing tickets and outstanding PRs.
Ryan (Product): Thanks everyone. Will write handover doc by EOD Fri. I'm fine with 30d email forwarding. Laptop return: can drop at office desk dropbox on 06-14.
Emily (HRBP): COBRA: benefits end date will be 2025-06-30 (end of exit month). We will send COBRA election notice within 14 days of termination. Final benefits-eligible date: 2025-06-13 (last day worked). We'll also trigger benefits admin to generate packet.
Maya (People Ops): Emily, can you confirm 401(k) info + equity guidance? Ryan — we'll schedule an exit interview the week after last day, do you prefer 30min or 60min?
Emily (HRBP): 401(k): Fidelity contact will reach out with rollover options; employee has 60 days to decide on rollover vs leave balance. Equity: vesting stops on last day; for specifics we'll loop in Payroll + StockOps. I'll DM both.
Sam (IT Ops): Deprovisioning plan (proposed):
```
- 2025-06-13 18:00 UTC: suspend Okta account (block interactive login)
- 2025-06-14 09:00 UTC: disable Slack and revoke tokens
- 2025-06-14 10:00 UTC: remove from GitHub org + revoke personal access tokens
- 2025-06-14 11:00 UTC: remove GCP roles except read-only prod-monitoring (retain until 2025-07-14)
- 2025-06-14 12:00 UTC: revoke AWS keys and remove IAM user
- 2025-06-14 13:00 UTC: deactivate Jira account
- 2025-06-14: laptop collected and imaged by IT
```
I'll open tickets and tag Leo for approvals. Any objections?
Leo (Eng Manager): Schedule looks good. Please leave GitHub repo access for the service account for monitoring, and ensure any deploy keys tied to Ryan's user are rotated.
AccessBot: Created ticket IT-4321: "Deprovision Ryan (ryan@redwood.ai)" assigned to Sam (IT Ops), due 2025-06-14.
Ryan (Product): Okay — small ask: keep access to internal wiki (read-only) for 90 days if possible, I may need to reference past docs.
Sam (IT Ops): We can do read-only wiki access for 90 days. Will note in IT-4321.
Maya (People Ops): Exit interview: Ryan, we propose 2025-06-16 11:00am PT (30min) with me + Emily. Does that work?
Ryan (Product): Works for me, thanks. Also confirm final paycheck date?
Emily (HRBP): Final paycheck will be on the regular payroll date following termination; final PTO payout per policy will be included. Payroll will email a confirmation; I'll CC you.
Maya (People Ops): Great — action items:
- Ryan: handover doc by EOD Fri (link to be posted)
- Sam: create IT-4321 and run deprovision plan above
- Emily: send COBRA packet + loop Payroll/StockOps
- Leo: confirm any repo/deploy key ownership transfers
I'll follow up with a short checklist and drop the laptop drop-off instructions. :wave:
Sam (IT Ops): I'll post the deprovision commands in IT ticket, examples: 
```bash
# revoke AWS keys
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name ryan | jq -r '.AccessKeyMetadata[].AccessKeyId' | xargs -I {} aws iam delete-access-key --user-name ryan --access-key-id {}
# remove from GitHub org
gh api orgs/redwood/memberships/ryan --method DELETE
# suspend Okta user (example)
okta-cli users suspend ryan@redwood.ai
```
Sam (IT Ops): tagging @Leo for final approvals on deploy key rotation.
Leo (Eng Manager): Approved. Thanks Sam and Maya.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks team. Ryan — we'll handle the rest and send calendar invites. Good luck and we'll keep in touch. :thumbsup:
